name: Crossbow Bolt
summary: Ammunition for Light, Hand and Heavy Crossbows; sold 20 at a time.
text: One piece of ammunition for Light, Hand and Heavy Crossbows. A bundle of 20 costs 1 GP and weighs 1.5 lb.; it is usually kept in a Crossbow Bolt Case, bought separately. Each attack with an Ammunition weapon uses one piece. After a fight, spending 1 minute lets you recover half of the pieces you used (round down); the rest are lost.
